quests.question: Seeing the dark clouds, they packed raincoats before the hike, choosing _____.
quests.explanation: Packing raincoats after spotting dark clouds shows good judgment, so wisely fits.

quests.question: After a twelve-hour flight across time zones, Ana yawned at noon and craved dinner at dawn; she was _____.
quests.explanation: A long flight across time zones and a body clock out of step (tired at noon, hungry at dawn) mean she was jet-lagged.

quests.question: The road wound past lakes, snow peaks and wildflowers; it was a _____ drive.
quests.explanation: Lakes, snow peaks and wildflowers along the road make a drive beautiful to look at: scenic.

quests.question: Every street sold the same fridge magnets and every café had a photo menu in six languages; it felt _____.
quests.explanation: Identical souvenirs and menus in six languages show a place built for visitors: touristy.

quests.question: A small wooden cabin with a fire and thick blankets felt warm and _____.
quests.explanation: A small cabin, a fire and thick blankets make a place warm and comfortable, so snug fits.

quests.question: Windows boarded, roof open to the sky and nobody living there for decades; the factory was _____.
quests.explanation: Boarded windows, an open roof and decades of abandonment describe a neglected ruin: derelict.

quests.question: Cars crawled bumper to bumper for an hour on a road built for half as many; the road was _____.
quests.explanation: Cars crawling bumper to bumper for an hour show overcrowded traffic, so congested fits.

quests.question: Even the tallest swimmer couldn't touch the bottom; the lake was _____.
quests.explanation: Not touching the bottom, even for the tallest swimmer, shows great depth, so deep fits.

quests.question: Our voices echoed in the huge empty hall with its soaring ceiling; the space was _____.
quests.explanation: Echoing voices, a huge empty hall and a soaring ceiling show a vast, cave-like space: cavernous.

quests.question: The hotel confirmed five more guests than it had beds; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Confirming more guests than beds means taking too many reservations: overbooked.

quests.question: After hiking for hours without drinking, his lips cracked and he felt dizzy; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Hiking for hours without drinking, cracked lips and dizziness are signs of lacking water: he was dehydrated.

quests.question: A single weak bulb lit the grey, grimy basement flat; it felt _____.
quests.explanation: One weak bulb and grey, grimy walls make a gloomy, dirty-looking space, so dingy fits.

quests.question: Freezing winds, bare rock and no water for miles made the region _____.
quests.explanation: Freezing winds, bare rock and no water make life there harsh and unwelcoming: inhospitable.

quests.question: Hearing the final boarding call, she crammed her things into her bag and sprinted off, packing _____.
quests.explanation: Grabbing bags and rushing after the announcement shows speed, so hurriedly fits; slowly contradicts.

quests.question: Children paddled safely in the water, which barely reached their knees; the pool was _____.
quests.explanation: Water that barely reaches the knees means little depth, so shallow fits; deep contradicts.

quests.question: We couldn't see the end of the pier, and car lights glowed dimly; the morning was _____.
quests.explanation: Not seeing the pier's end and dim glowing lights show poor visibility, so foggy fits.

quests.question: Rats in the corridors, raw sewage in the yard and no running water; conditions were _____.
quests.explanation: Rats, sewage and no water show filthy, wretched living conditions, which is squalid.

quests.question: The cereal sat in milk for an hour and turned limp and mushy; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Sitting in milk for an hour and going limp and mushy shows it soaked up liquid: soggy.

quests.question: The coach rattled over potholes and everyone's cups jumped; the ride was _____.
quests.explanation: Rattling over potholes and jumping cups show a jolting journey, so bumpy fits; smooth contradicts.

quests.question: After a day on the beach with no lotion, her shoulders were red and sore; she was _____.
quests.explanation: A day on the beach without lotion and red, sore shoulders show skin damaged by sun: sunburnt.

quests.question: After a night in the storm, they accepted the villagers' soup and blankets _____.
quests.explanation: Accepting soup and blankets after a night in a storm shows thankfulness, so gratefully fits.

quests.question: Flickering neon, shady characters and sticky floors made the bar feel _____.
quests.explanation: Flickering neon, shady characters and sticky floors suggest a run-down, disreputable place: seedy.

quests.question: Hats flew off, flags snapped and the umbrella turned inside out; the day was _____.
quests.explanation: Flying hats, snapping flags and an inside-out umbrella show strong gusts: windy.

quests.question: The fine print said that if you cancel, you lose the full deposit; the ticket was _____.
quests.explanation: Losing the full deposit on cancelling means no money back, which is non-refundable.

quests.question: The room hadn't been aired in years and smelled of old books and mothballs; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A room unaired for years that smells of old books and mothballs is stale and musty: fusty.

quests.question: Boulders and loose stones covered the path, so the trail was _____.
quests.explanation: Boulders and loose stones across the path make the trail rocky; smooth and sandy contradict.

quests.question: The cyclist climbed and descended all day without ever riding on flat ground; the route was _____.
quests.explanation: Climbing and descending all day with no flat ground describes a route full of hills: hilly.

quests.question: Tapping his foot and checking his watch, he waited _____ for the train.
quests.explanation: Tapping a foot and checking a watch show restless waiting, so impatiently fits; calmly and patiently contradict.

quests.question: The old hotel had sagging stairs, peeling plaster and a lift that hadn't worked in years; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Sagging stairs, peeling plaster and a dead lift show worn-out, run-down condition: decrepit.

quests.question: No rush, no schedule; they strolled along the river and stopped for coffee at a _____ pace.
quests.explanation: 'No rush, no schedule' and strolling point to a slow, relaxed pace, so leisurely fits.
